item.title: Bank Unions Call Strike on January 27 Over Five-Day Work Week Demand; Four-Day Shutdown on Cards
item.description: GUWAHATI: The United Forum of Bank Unions (UFBU), an umbrella body representing nine major unions of bank employees and officers, has announced a nationwide bank strike on January 27 to press for government approval of a five-day work week in the banking sector. item.title: Meitei Man Abducted, Shot Dead in Manipur’s Churachandpur
item.description: GUWAHATI: In a fresh escalation of ethnic tensions in Manipur, a man identified as Mayanglambam Rishikanta Singh was abducted and shot by unidentified armed men in Churachandpur district. The incident has reignited tensions in the state, as police officials seek to verify and investigate a viral video that allegedly captures the victim pleading for his life shortly before the killing. item.title: A Month Later, Police Continue to Wait for Postmortem Report on Death of Pandu College Student; Probe Stalled
item.description: GUWAHATI: The city's Jalukbari police are awaiting the postmortem report in connection with the death of Pandu College student Rubail Alam, whose body was recovered from the Ambikagiri Boys’ Hostel on December 17, 2025. With the forensic report yet to arrive, police have said it is too early to conclude whether the case involves suicide or a planned crime. item.title: Mayor Without a Mandate: How Mrigen Sarania’s Assembly Ambitions Keep Hitting BJP’s Wall

item.description: GUWAHATI: In a significant development in the Ganeshpara robbery case, the Fatasil Ambari police have detained three suspects in connection with the incident that took place earlier this week. The detention was carried out on the night of Wednesday, January 21, and police officials confirmed that interrogation of the suspects is currently underway.
